requirements: Use conversational Ctrl/Shift page selection guidance
Wider sticky edition headers with readable titles and useful space distribution
Remove close-comparison X from row headers; top comparison toggles remain
Three mutually exclusive per-edition modes: keep, partial, remove, with matching colors and restrained animation
Ctrl/Shift page selection automatically activates partial mode from keep or remove
Preserve selections, evidence validation, horizontal virtualization, vertical/Shift-horizontal wheel routing, remembered outer window size
Minimum app text size equals current compact-card title: 13px; raise formerly small text and modestly raise heading sizes to preserve hierarchy
Adjust line height, control/card geometry and responsive layout for enlarged text
design: Stage changes away from live app
Edition mode changes are drafts, never destructive until explicit apply/confirmation
Existing source revisions, quarantine and merge safeguards remain enforced
Do not silently clear Ctrl/Shift selections on mode/filter/comparison changes
Shared minimum typography token and audited declaration changes; decorative icon geometry is independent from text sizing
Keep vendor/generated source assets intact; use adapters for isolated owned chat/player content
A partial destination keeps only explicit selected pages; original target and donor files remain protected by existing backup/quarantine transactions.
Apply freezes all compared or deliberately drafted editions; validates all plans before writes, reloads revision per operation and keeps unprocessed selections after failure.
Native work runs behind a nonmodal status; hidden review keeps drafts but suspends page rendering. Successful batch closes review and refreshes library once.

Multiple page-changing merges in one batch are rejected before writes because earlier merges invalidate later fingerprints; multi-edition keep/remove decisions and a single trailing partial merge are supported.
